Before I can validate the proposal, we must resolve the UI/UX and integration research gaps identified in your intelligence report. Please conduct a deep-dive to determine the specifics of the front-end framework used by the Devio workspace (e.g., React webview vs HTML/CSS/JS) and how the backend currently emits state changes (e.g., polling, WebSockets) to trigger the indicator visibility.

Research complete. The Devio workspace frontend is a React webview built with Vite (@vitejs/plugin-react). For backend state emission, it does not use WebSockets or polling. Instead, it relies on VS Code's vscode.workspace.createFileSystemWatcher to monitor agency_workspace/inbox.jsonl for file changes, and then pushes state updates to the React frontend using the standard webview.postMessage API.
